name: @qf-jarvis/model-evaluation
description: QF Jarvis evaluation and red-team foundation (QFJ-P04.04). A dedicated, provider-neutral, version-bound, deterministic evaluation + red-team EVIDENCE system that scores pre-supplied candidate observations against synthetic fixtures and closed thresholds, producing immutable approval evidence for later rollout approval. It invokes NO model: no live Groq/local call, no real key/token, no LLM-as-judge, no model voting, no real conversation data. Evaluation evidence informs operations; it activates and promotes nothing. No database/persistence, no schema/migration, no semantic retrieval/embeddings/vector DB/RAG. Depends only on zod.
